Membership

Your membership. Your voice.

Both membership options support the PTO and give you access to member benefits. Choose the option that works best for your family!

Help shape PTO decisions

The Thrive PTO is led by a PTO Board and its members, and some important PTO decisions and changes require a membership vote. Your membership gives you a voice in those decisions.
